summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a petition to an Israeli court to authorize a meeting of Series D Convertible Debenture holders to approve reducing the conversion price from NIS 165 (~$55.7) to NIS 75.95 (~$25.6) per share. The debentures, due December 31, 2026, are currently convertible into 375,757 ordinary shares; if approved, they become convertible into 816,326 shares. The reduction is part of agreements with debenture holders to address liquidity concerns, as detailed in its 20-F. Approvals required include court, debenture holder, and NYSE American listing. Watch for court and shareholder approval timelines and potential dilution impact.
